method: Claude's visual judgement of the 100 spots R15b's scoring rule calls false alarms in the R15f careful-mode set, in id order, from contact sheets showing both views (72-px close-up and 144-px wider view, each at 216 px); made and committed before the operator session, so blind to the answers. person = a person or rider at the ring; not_person = clearly an object or empty ground at the ring; ambiguous = cannot tell from the views.
